name: Kettlebell Double Clean and Jerk
steps: Stand with two kettlebells between your feet, hinge at your hips, and clean both bells simultaneously into the front rack position.
Keep your torso upright and dip slightly at the knees with both bells supported in the rack.
Drive explosively upward through your legs, then drop quickly into a second shallow knee dip as you punch both arms locked overhead.
Stand tall to finish the jerk, lower both bells cleanly back to the rack, and swing them back into the next clean.
tips: Let your legs generate the upward drive for the jerk rather than pressing slowly with your shoulders.
Pause briefly at overhead lockout with stacked wrists and straight elbows before dropping the bells back to the rack.
